summary: Implemented the 3-tab bottom navigation (Offers, Saved, Profile) in the Expo mobile app. Replaced starter Home/Explore tabs with Offers (index), Saved, and Profile routes. Added mock offer data, OfferCard component, AsyncStorage-backed saved offers via SavedOffersProvider context, and placeholder profile menu. Installed @react-native-async-storage/async-storage, removed explore.tsx, and updated native/web tab components. TypeScript check passes.
current_status: Mobile app has working bottom tab navigation with mock offers list, local bookmark persistence across tabs, saved offers screen with empty state, and profile placeholder UI. Backend integration and auth remain future work.
